QUOTE: "Built-in heap: `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (`memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`) carves allocations out of a caller-supplied buffer and never calls libc. It installs its own allocator by calling `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init installs itself via the setter, but never says it is the only in-tree user. It even says the runtime route "is the path the library's own helpers use," which is plural.
